final_message:
I found no firm matter that documented, negotiated to final form, or closed a springing-lien financing. The only direct reference is the 2024 Penterra markup memo (1018-00008), where we confirmed the lender draft had no springing lien, acting for the borrower; that deal never closed. The closest closed precedent is the equal-and-ratable negative pledge in the Verimark notes (1021-00002, closed June 2024), and every other "springing" hit concerns something other than a lien. The 1018-00008 file also disagrees with itself on whether that facility was secured, which response.md flags.
